feeling: Relieved for about four seconds — it's not bitter, it said so, fine. Then cornered. It answered a question I didn't ask and now I feel like I got caught doing something. A little annoyed. And underneath the annoyed, the worse thing, which is that it's not completely wrong and I hate that it's not completely wrong.
body: Read the first paragraph and my shoulders actually dropped. Then 'I don't think tone is what's making you pause' and they came right back up. Jaw. I read the 'knowing they flinched' line twice, then scrolled back up to my own draft like I needed to check whether it was in there. Put the phone face down on the duvet. Picked it up again after maybe ten seconds. Thumb hovering, which is annoying because that's literally what it said.
private_thoughts: ok so it's not petty. good. that's what I asked. and then it just... keeps going. 'but I don't think tone is what's making you pause.' cool, thanks, I asked one thing. the flinch line though. did I want him to flinch. I mean. no. I want him to know. that's different. is that different. it's different. 'forwarding your closure to someone who wasn't part of arriving at it' — that's a good line and it sounds like something on a mug and also it's kind of not the point. it didn't actually say anything about what he DID. it said I named specific things, gave me a gold star for naming, and then went straight to me. what I want, what I need, be honest with yourself. I'm being honest with myself, that's why there's a draft. priya says send it, this says maybe don't, everyone's got an opinion on what I do with the thing that happened to me. also it's 11pm and I wanted a yes.
pushing_away: if I don't send it then it just sits in my notes and I'm the one holding it. again. and he never has to— no. it's a text. that's not the same thing as. it's not the same thing.

costs.item: The specific things he did (the job jokes, your mom)
Admitting how much it actually hurt

message:
ok. I did ask about tone though and you did like two sentences on it and then went straight to what's going on with me. which, fine, I did say I don't know why I keep pausing so I guess I opened that door.

but the flinch thing. I don't need him to flinch, I've actually thought about that. I think it's more that I never said any of it when it was happening. the email bit, I laughed along. every time. Marc would look at me and I'd laugh. so writing it and then not sending it feels like doing that again just with extra steps. that's why the draft sitting in my notes app isn't the same as sending it, at least not to me.

is that a reason to send it or is that the exact thing you're saying to watch out for. genuinely asking, I can't tell anymore
